---
title: "isoweek"
description: "Calculate the ISO 8601 week number for a given date or datetime"
---

## Overview

`isoweek` calculates the **ISO 8601 week number** (01–53) for a given date or
datetime string. Supports both local time and UTC.

```bash
$ isoweek 2025-01-03
01

$ isoweek -u 2025-12-31
01
```

## Dependencies

- `date` (GNU coreutils)

## Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-u, --utc` | Calculate using UTC time |
| `-h, --help` | Show help and exit. |

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `DATETIME` | Date or datetime string accepted by GNU `date -d` (required) |

## Usage

```bash
# ISO week for a date (local time)
isoweek 2025-01-03

# ISO week in UTC
isoweek -u 2025-01-03

# Full datetime string
isoweek 2024-12-30T00:00:00+09:00
```

## Notes

- ISO week 1 is the week containing the first Thursday of the year.
- `2025-01-03` falls in **week 01** of 2025.
- `2024-12-30` falls in **week 01** of 2025 (not week 53 of 2024).
- The script uses GNU `date -d`; macOS `date` is not compatible.
